subject.title: fix(mattermost): key private channels as group on outbound routing

question: Should this PR remain proof-blocked until the author posts inspectable redacted session-store or log output for the live private-channel run?
rationale: The source and tests support the fix, but the central live claim is stored session namespace state that is not visible in the current screenshot.

options.title: Require inspectable session proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the author adds redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing the private-channel delivery reused `group:<id>` without creating a phantom `channel:<id>` session.

options.title: Accept proof gap deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can merge on source and unit-test evidence alone, but that owns the risk that the live session-store claim was not independently inspectable.

options.title: Pick one canonical landing path
options.body: Once this PR is selected and proof is adequate, pause or close the partial same-issue PR so the cluster has one fix path.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable session proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the author adds redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing the private-channel delivery reused `group:<id>` without creating a phantom `channel:<id>` session.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and adjacent Mattermost chat-type history point to this person as the strongest available owner for proof sufficiency and landing-path selection.
